generation.prompt:
Flat orthographic 2D web chess play board only — no pieces, no labels, no UI chrome. Output as clean vector SVG game art.

Canvas: square. Full readable 8×8 grid on a quiet mahogany cafe table plane with a clear wooden feel.
- Light squares: warm pale wood #E8D5B5 (PAL.C1) — not stark white; soft wood tone
- Dark squares: deep mahogany #8B5A3C (PAL.C2) — dominant warm brown
- Table / frame / margin: rich mahogany #5C3A2A (PAL.C5) surrounding the grid
- Wooden feel: visible but soft wood grain and warm lacquered wood surface on table, frame, and squares; grain never breaks square edges or contrast (SRF.M1)

Mood: quiet mahogany cafe (P3); warm soft daylight (SRF.L1); square readability first. Soft-matte flat vector language matching the piece style — calm wooden board, not plastic, not chrome, not photoreal macro wood.

No perspective, no isometric tilt, no heavy 3D bevels.

Avoid: neon; esports chrome; cold grey board; bright white squares; 3D perspective board; cluttered props; blood; piece sprites; text; badges; plastic laminate look.
